home.metaTitle: Marcel Kück — Independent R&D Engineer · Munich
home.metaDescription: Independent R&D engineer in Munich. I design and build prototypes, electronics, robotic systems and AI software, from first concept to working hardware, in my own workshop.

hero.label: Independent R&D Engineer · Munich
hero.intro: I'm Marcel, an independent R&D engineer. I develop new products and prototypes across mechanics, electronics, software and AI, and I build them in my own workshop, with FDM and resin 3D printers, a CNC machine and a well-stocked electronics bench.
hero.background: My background: computer science at TU Munich, software engineering at Siemens, two co-founded SaaS companies, and research in robotics at Devanthro and in tissue engineering at the University of Oxford.
hero.imageAlt: Marcel Kück, independent R&D engineer in Munich

disciplines.label: What I do
disciplines.body: Prototypes rarely fail inside a single discipline. They fail where disciplines meet: the sensor that doesn't fit the housing, the firmware that can't keep up with the motor, the model that runs on a laptop but not on the device. I work across all four, so those interfaces get solved by one person instead of being passed between three teams.

mechanics.title: Mechanics & fabrication
mechanics.body: Parts designed in CAD and made in-house, from the first print to the CNC-machined component.

electronics.title: Electronics & firmware
electronics.body: Electronics that sense, control and drive hardware, and the firmware that runs on it.

software.title: Software & systems
software.body: The software around the hardware, and software products in their own right.

ai.title: AI & robotics
ai.body: Learning systems on real hardware, and AI that does real work inside a business.

workshop.label: The workshop
workshop.body: Most of what I design gets made right here. Print overnight, test in the morning, change the CAD by noon. That loop is the reason I keep my own workshop: no waiting on a supplier for every revision, and nothing gets lost between the drawing and the part.

fdm.title: FDM 3D printing
fdm.body: Functional parts, housings, brackets and jigs. Fast and cheap enough to print three variants and keep the best one.

resin.title: Resin 3D printing
resin.body: Fine detail and smooth surfaces for small mechanisms, fluid chambers and parts that need to look finished.

cnc.title: CNC machining
cnc.body: For parts that need to be stiffer, more precise or more durable than a print.

electronics.title: Electronics bench
electronics.body: Components, sensors and microcontrollers in stock, plus the tools to solder, measure and debug them.

loop.title: The loop
loop.body: Design, build, test, repeat. With everything under one roof, a prototype can go through several revisions in the time it takes an outsourced part to arrive.

work.label: Selected work
work.body: Research hardware, robots, connected devices and AI systems. Some for clients, some for research, some because I wanted them to exist.

about.label: About
about.p1: I studied computer science at TU Munich and worked as a backend engineer at Siemens for two years alongside my studies. After graduating, I spent two years at Devanthro on embodied AI and robotics control, first as a research engineer, then as founders associate. I then co-founded two SaaS companies: ShareYourSpace, a coworking marketplace acquired by Pixida GmbH in 2026, and Rechnungs-API, an API for invoice automation.
about.p2: Today I work as an independent R&D engineer. Alongside client projects, I continue my research at Devanthro on the OpenArm platform and at the University of Oxford with Prof. Pierre-Alexis Mouthuy on sensor-integrated bioreactors for artificial muscles.
about.p3: And I keep building things for myself. A smart coffee roaster I built quietly turned into a small roasting brand, <marieLou>Marie Lou Coffee</marieLou>. I retrofit espresso machines, train robot arms, run more smart home experiments than strictly necessary and write my own machine learning and robotics frameworks in Rust.

about.imageAltRobot: Marcel Kück next to a humanoid robot in a robotics lab

contact.label: Contact
contact.body: Tell me about the problem, the idea or the half-finished prototype on your desk. A few sentences are enough to start, and if I'm not the right person for it, I'll say so.

projects.metaDescription: Research hardware, robots, connected devices, AI systems and founded companies: a selection of projects by Marcel Kück, independent R&D engineer in Munich.
projects.label: Projects
projects.intro: Research hardware, robots, connected devices, AI systems and a few companies. A mix of client work, research and personal projects, open source where possible.

cta.body: Tell me what you're working on. A few sentences are enough to start.

oxfordBioreactor.title: Soft Bioreactor · University of Oxford
oxfordBioreactor.summary: A soft, flexible bioreactor chamber for growing skeletal muscle tissue, with perfusion and mechanical stimulation. Designed in Fusion 360, SLA-printed and extended with integrated sensing.
oxfordBioreactor.description: Soft, flexible bioreactor chamber for skeletal muscle tissue engineering at the Department of Materials, hosted by Prof. Pierre-Alexis Mouthuy. Supports dual perfusion and mechanical stimulation through electrospun hollow fiber scaffolds. Chamber designed in Fusion 360 and produced by SLA 3D printing. The brief was extended with integrated sensing and exploratory machine learning.

coffeeRoaster.title: Smart Coffee Roaster
coffeeRoaster.summary: A connected roaster with closed-loop temperature control and roast profiles that can be recorded and replayed. Started as a side project, ended up as a coffee brand.
coffeeRoaster.description: Connected coffee roaster with roast profile recording and replay. Closed-loop temperature control on a Raspberry Pi, custom firmware and a small web UI for managing roasts. Also the origin of <marieLou>Marie Lou Coffee</marieLou>.

leRobot.title: SO-101 Manipulator · LeRobot
leRobot.summary: Vision-language-action policies trained end to end and deployed on a real SO-101 robot arm, for experiments in imitation learning and bimanual manipulation.
leRobot.description: End-to-end training of vision-language-action policies and deployment on the SO-101 arm with Hugging Face's LeRobot framework. Used for experiments in imitation learning and bimanual manipulation.

openArm.title: OpenArm Platform
openArm.description: Open robotics platform for embodied AI research. Current work at Devanthro: motion control and integration with foundation models.

laMarcello.title: La Marcello
laMarcello.description: Retrofit controller that turns classic espresso machines into smart, connected appliances. PID temperature control and flow profiling on a custom firmware stack.

motionSports.title: Motion Sports AI Agent
motionSports.summary: An AI assistant inside a German online shop that handles consultation, orders, returns and after-sales, connected to inventory, order data and customer history.
motionSports.description: Integrated AI assistant for a German online retailer. Handles consultation, orders, returns and after-sales directly in the shop, connected to inventory, order data and customer history, with handover to a human when needed.

mdkEngineeringBot.title: MDK Engineering Bot
mdkEngineeringBot.description: Telegram-based automation agent for the repetitive parts of running a freelance practice: bookkeeping, tax preparation, invoice tracking and financial reporting. Pulls from connected accounts, classifies transactions and answers questions in chat. The same kind of agent built for clients, used on my own business first.

rustyRobots.title: RustyRobots
rustyRobots.description: Open-source robotics framework for embodied AI, written in Rust. Modular crates for perception, control and simulation integration.

rustML.title: RustML
rustML.description: Open-source machine learning framework written in Rust. Implements tensor operations, automatic differentiation and inference.

marieLouCoffee.title: Marie Lou Coffee
marieLouCoffee.description: Small specialty coffee roasting brand that grew out of the smart coffee roaster. From a one-off hardware build to a real product: branding, packaging, web shop and roasting workflow.

rechnungsApi.title: Rechnungs-API
rechnungsApi.description: SaaS API for automated invoice generation, validation and ZUGFeRD/XRechnung compliance. Built and operated as a co-founder.

shareYourSpace.title: ShareYourSpace
shareYourSpace.description: Marketplace connecting companies with flexible coworking and meeting spaces. Co-founded and led product engineering. Acquired by Pixida GmbH in 2026.

murph.title: Murph
murph.description: Online platform pairing medical students with older people for accessible, plain-language health advice. Full-stack web application.

svEsting.title: SV Esting · Gymnastics App
svEsting.description: Full-stack web app for the gymnastics department of SV Esting. Handles group organization, training management and member communication for around 200 active users.

work.metaDescription: R&D engineering for startups, industrial companies and research teams: feasibility studies, prototype development, electronics and firmware, robotics, lab equipment and AI automation.

hero.label: Work with me
hero.body: I work with startups, industrial companies and research teams that need something built that doesn't exist yet: a prototype, a test rig, a piece of lab equipment, a robot that has to learn a task, or the software and AI that tie it all together. Engagements range from a short feasibility study to several months of development.

startups.title: Startups
startups.body: A first functional prototype to test with users, show to investors or take into a pilot.

industry.title: Industry & mid-sized companies
industry.body: Extra R&D capacity for a new product or test setup, or for bringing AI and automation into existing processes, without building a team for it.

research.title: Research teams
research.body: Custom lab equipment, sensor setups and data pipelines, designed around your experiment.

feasibility.title: Feasibility study
feasibility.body: One to two days on your problem. You get a written assessment: what's technically possible, where the risks are, which approach I'd take and what the effort looks like.

prototype.title: Prototype development
prototype.body: From concept to a working prototype: CAD, printed and machined parts, electronics, firmware and the software around it, built and tested in my workshop.
prototype.meta: Prototype · CAD files · BOM · source code

electronics.title: Electronics & firmware
electronics.body: Sensor integration, microcontroller firmware, closed-loop control and data acquisition. For new devices, or to make existing equipment measurable and controllable.

robotics.title: Robotics & embodied AI
robotics.body: Manipulators, motion control and robot learning, from imitation learning to vision-language-action policies, tested on real hardware.

lab.title: Lab equipment & test rigs
lab.body: Custom devices for research groups and R&D teams: bioreactors, test benches, fixtures and measurement setups, built around the experiment.

ai.title: AI agents & automation
ai.body: Production-ready AI agents, workflow automation and integrations for business processes, from customer support assistants to internal tools.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.body: 30 minutes, free. You explain what you want to build, I ask a lot of questions.

steps.title: Feasibility
steps.body: One to two days of research and concept work. You get a written plan covering approach, risks and effort.

steps.title: Build & iterate
steps.body: Development in short cycles with regular demos. You see real progress, not status reports.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Documentation, CAD files, source code and bill of materials. Everything your team needs to carry on, with optional ongoing support.

motionSports.title: Motion Sports
motionSports.body: An AI assistant inside a German online shop that handles consultation, order support, returns and after-sales, connected to inventory, order data and customer history.
